shortBulletSummary: The crypto market lost over $100 billion, with Bitcoin falling to $77,878 and Ether to $2,170, as $580M+ in long positions were liquidated.
Hotter-than-expected US inflation (CPI at 3.8%) and rising bond yields (US 10-year over 4.5%) are increasing Fed rate hike expectations.
Ongoing US-Iran tensions and higher oil prices are contributing to global market uncertainty, impacting risk assets like crypto.
The Crypto Clarity Act advanced through the Senate Banking Committee, signaling a step towards clearer US crypto regulation.
Spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced significant outflows, recording $1 billion in net redemptions for the week ending May 15.
